results.answer: A 2025 study of 100+ B2B SaaS companies found a $29/user/month median entry plan. SMB-focused tiers had medians of $15 (Starter), $35 (Professional) and $65 (Business) per user per month, and the median per-user price across all segments was $45/month. Most micro-SaaS products are small: about 70% earn under $1,000 MRR, and the median profitable one makes about $4.2K MRR.
